- File: .claude/commands/write-plan.md
  Line or code reference: line 13 (step 4) — "By the time you reach this step, there are no open questions left — step 3's loop must have resolved every one."
  Problem: If a genuinely new ambiguity surfaces during step 4 drafting (a dependency clash, a previously unseen code interaction, a contract the agent only discovers while writing the plan), there is no documented fallback.
  Why it fails at runtime: The agent encountering a step-4 discovery would either silently suppress it (violating "never silently default"), or improvise by going back to step 3 without documented authority — both are operational gaps.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
